title: Buidler Fest 2025 Recap: Why Developers Build on Cardano
description:
Buidler Fest brought together Cardano developers from around the world for in-person collaboration, technical deep dives, and hands-on problem solving.

Why do developers choose Cardano? From its deterministic transaction model and strong security guarantees to its architecture as a global anchor of trust, developers share what drew them to Cardano and why they keep building on it.

Topics covered at this year's event included node development, protocol design, determinism, and Cardano's infrastructure as a foundation for secure, verifiable, enterprise-grade systems.

Buidler Fest Argentina was organized by TxPipe, Cardano Ambassadors Mauro Andreoli and Lucas Macchiavelli, and funded by Project Catalyst. Sponsors for this event included the Cardano Foundation, IOG, Intersect, Cardano Ambassador Program, and Midnight.

Learn more about Buidler Fest: https://buidlerfest.com/ 
Discover enterprise blockchain solutions: cardanofoundation.org 
Follow us on LinkedIn: linkedin.com/company/cardano-foundation
Follow us on X: x.com/Cardano_CF
